summary: community.crypto 3.0.0 will drop ansible-core 2.11 to 2.16 and Python before 3.7 (including targets), drop cryptography below 3.4, and remove the PyOpenSSL backend of openssl_pkcs12 (requiring cryptography 3.0+).
questions: What ansible-core version will community.crypto 3 need?
Will openssl_pkcs12 still work with PyOpenSSL?
Which cryptography library version is required going forward?

answer_card.title: community.crypto 3.0.0 requirements
answer_card.answer_md:
In community.crypto 3.0.0:
- ansible-core 2.11 to 2.16 are dropped, along with Python below 3.7 on controller and targets.
- `cryptography` below 3.4 is dropped.
- `openssl_pkcs12` loses its PyOpenSSL backend and needs `cryptography` 3.0+.
